key_decisions: 1.3.0 is the right digit: 2nd digit = new model (FLUX.2 Klein) + new ops. 1.2.0 was released 2026-07-24 and is the current tag.

The masking changelog hold was released deliberately. The code for SAM3 points/text, the four-tool split and canvas undo is already on master and ships in 1.3 whether documented or not; shapes (MPI-368) is NOT making this release, so waiting for it would have shipped four user-visible features silently.
MPI-346 closed on LOCAL evidence with the remote drift-ladder leg left on MPI-385, per the standing rule that a card whose only leftover is remote closes locally and adds a line to that umbrella.
MPI-370 (macOS install fix) is explicitly NOT a blocker - code-verified and negative-controlled but no Apple hardware. Broken-with-an-unverified-fix beats broken. Ship it.

STALE TEST, do not 'fix' the code: tests/permodel-key-allowlist.test.cjs fails claiming krea2Turbo/qualityTier/styleSelect/stylization/enhancePrompt are missing from _MODEL_WIDE_KEYS, which genuinely only holds {loras, upscaleModel}. But js/services/projectService.js:209-213 documents that MPI-336 deliberately REPLACED the allowlist with a modelWide flag derived from the control's own scope. A live sidecar from this session confirms correct behaviour (controlState.model carried krea2Turbo:false). Rewrite or delete the test.
constraints: SHARED TREE: another agent is working MPI-387 in a separate session and is actively editing main.js and install code. Commit by explicit pathspec only. Coordinate via mpi-message if needed.
CLAIMED BY ANOTHER SESSION - DO NOT TOUCH: MPI-378 (Tab as a workspace flipper). The user is handling it separately. Leave the card and its files alone.

COMFYUI_PORT = 8188 is hardcoded (routes/shared.js:134) and the launcher is IDEMPOTENT - routes/comfy.js:324 probes /history and attaches to whatever already answers. The user's standalone G:\ComfyUi bench also uses 8188, so it MUST be closed before app testing or the app silently dispatches into the bench (different install, different extra_model_paths.yaml).

The app UI resists synthetic DOM driving: the op strip radio group ignores JS .click() (custom event wiring) and is not exposed in the accessibility tree, so playwright-cli snapshot refs do not reach it. Pressing Escape inside a project navigates BACK to the landing screen. Driving generations by DOM is not worth the turns - ask the user to click, or attach to the Electron window's remote-debugging port instead of the browser client.

A raw file copied into a project's Media/ folder shows in the asset COUNT but never appears in the gallery - the grid renders itemGroups from project.json. Import through the app or generate, do not copy files in.

Krea2 tier 1 is expensive: 25 steps at cfg 2 = 50 model evaluations (ComfyUI only skips the uncond pass at cfg 1), and an edit roughly doubles the attended sequence because Krea2EditModelPatch prepends the reference as RoPE frame 1. Measured 388.8s for a 1024x1024 edit on a 4060 Ti. This is expected, not a defect.
Pod runtime promote is a LIVE op affecting released users - never auto-promote in the release flow. Currently no drift, so nothing to do.
